scope: Proposition 8.1 (Localized gradient and opening estimates) of the manuscript “Uniqueness of tangent flows at the first singular time of embedded surface mean-curvature flow” (preprints/Tangent-flow-uniqueness-2026-09-24/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 355 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 19b2f77a4cbfb0d5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 88. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are θ ∈ (0, 1/2) and γ > 0 with the following property. For every sufficiently small η > 0 there are a neighbor- hood of S on the observation core, a weak normal height and slope tolerance, and Rη, Cη < ∞ such that the following holds. Suppose M obeys (8.2), its observations lie in that neighbor- hood, and M is a complete graph with that weak tolerance over Sb to radius R ≥ Rη. Put D = ∥ΦM ∥L2 G(M) + e−(1−η)R2/8 . (8.5) Then |F(M) − F(S)|1−θ ≤ CηD, |x| ≤ CηDγ . (8.6) For each fixed compact reference region K, transported to Kb ⊂ Sb by the family charts, there are Rη,K ≥ Rη and Cη,K < ∞ such that, when R ≥ Rη,K, the normal height u of M satisfies ∥u∥H2(Kb) ≤ Cη,K(D + Dγ ). (8.7) When D ≤ 1, the right side can be replaced by Cη,KDγ. Also |λ(b, 0)| ≤ Cη(D + Dγ ). (8.8) The exponents θ, γ are independent of η; the neighborhood, tolerance, minimum radius, and constants need not be.
